description: Found during the fz-k22.10 spike. Running the SAME compiled binary for enum_predicate_search 3 times produced 3 DIFFERENT failure messages -- the affected producer materialization is schedule-dependent / non-deterministic. Per the campaigns rule (tiny-fixture slowness/instability = correctness), non-determinism here is a real correctness signal (a non-monotone join or unordered iteration in the callable/boundary materialization path), not flakiness to tolerate. Isolate via repeated runs + --log-telemetry diff; likely a HashMap-iteration-order or schedule-order dependence in the callable_for_producer / fallback_callable_boundary / materialize_transport_value path surfaced by the multi-resolution case. Blocks trusting any run/build result for enum_predicate_search until deterministic. Relates to fz-k22.10 (Bug A) and the new Bug B.

comments.text: SAME ROOT as fz-k22.10: the non-determinism is the 'arbitrary survivor' in semantic.rs CallSiteSummary coalescing (merge_callsite_activation discards a divergent arrow; which one survives depends on observation/HashMap order). Fixing fz-k22.10 (key coalescing by full ActivationKey, no arbitrary discard) should make it deterministic by construction. Verify determinism is restored when fz-k22.10 lands; likely closes as a dup.

title: fz-k22: enum_predicate_search producer materialization is non-deterministic across runs (3 different failure messages in 3 runs of the same binary)
